summary: The claim expresses opposition to sunsetting the E-rate program and emphasizes its critical role in enabling small districts to provide essential broadband services to students.

claims.argument: Without E-rate discounts, small districts could not afford high costs of broadband infrastructure
claims.evidence_quote: Without E-rate discounts, small districts simply could not afford the high cost of enterprise-grade fiber, modern network equipment, and internal Wi-Fi infrastructure.
